**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}

Dear [Mr Humbert](../persons.html#730),
I have just received a note from [Lady Susanna Blunt](../persons.html#164) asking me the day and time of the opening of [St Cross](../others.html#130), and whether tickets will be necessary for admission to the services.

Being unable to be present I had unfortunately destroyed the notice you were so good as to send me, and thus I cannot answer her questions.

Would you therefore be kind enough to send one of the papers to her husband -
the [Revd Colvin Blunt](../persons.html#2077)
Ryde View
Alverstoke
Gosport
And you will much oblige
Yours faithfully

C M Yonge

[^1]: The reopening of St.

Cross Hospital after its restoration took place on 19 October 1865; see the Hampshire Advertiser (21 October 1865) 4.
